root_cause: BuildKit temp directory has wrong permissions on the CI host; possibly caused by rootless Docker mode change
fix_command: sudo chown -R root:root /var/lib/docker/tmp && sudo systemctl restart docker && docker buildx build -t $IMAGE .

error_message: error: failed to fetch metadata: fork/exec /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-buildx: exec format error

error_message:

error parsing HTTP 403 response body: unexpected end of JSON input: ""
root_cause: ECR repository does not exist or the IAM role lacks ecr:GetAuthorizationToken and ecr:PushImage permissions
fix_command: aws ecr create-repository --repository-name $REPO --region $REGION && aws ecr get-login-password | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin $ECR_URI && docker push $IMAGE

error_message: docker build failed with exit code 2: dockerfile: COPY failed: file not found in build context or excluded by .dockerignore: stat dist/main.js: file does not exist

error_message:

Container my-app-1 exited with status 1

error_message: CrashLoopBackOff: Back-off restarting failed container my-app in pod my-app-7f8b6d4f9-xk2nl
root_cause: Kubernetes pod container is crash-looping due to misconfigured liveness probe or application startup failure
fix_command: kubectl rollout restart deployment/$DEPLOYMENT -n $NAMESPACE && kubectl rollout status deployment/$DEPLOYMENT -n $NAMESPACE

error_message:
Error: container exited with code 137. This is typically caused by the container being killed (OOM or SIGKILL).
Container: my-svc-prod (id: a8f2b3c4d5e6)

error_message:
docker compose up failed: service 'web' failed to start: container my_project_web_1 exited with code 1
Error response from daemon: OCI runtime create failed
root_cause: Docker Compose service container fails on startup due to missing entrypoint script or broken CMD instruction
fix_command: docker compose down && docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up -d

error_message: Error response from daemon: driver failed programming external connectivity on endpoint myapp (abc123): Bind for 0.0.0.0:80 failed: port is already allocated
root_cause: Port 80 already bound by another container or process; Docker cannot start new container on same port
fix_command: docker ps | grep ':80->' && docker rm -f $(docker ps -q --filter 'publish=80') && docker start $CONTAINER_ID

error_message: Container 'web' is unhealthy. Health check command '/usr/bin/curl --silent --fail http://localhost:8080/health' returned non-zero exit status 7.
root_cause: Application is not listening on the expected health check port; possibly wrong port configuration or startup crash
fix_command: docker exec $CONTAINER_ID curl -sf http://localhost:$PORT/health || docker restart $CONTAINER_ID && sleep 10 && docker inspect --format='{{.State.Health.Status}}' $CONTAINER_ID

error_message:
Error: Cannot restart container: container id must be between 8 and 64 characters
[exit status 125]
root_cause: Automation script passing empty or malformed container ID to docker restart due to grepping non-running container
fix_command: CONTAINER_ID=$(docker ps -qf name=$APP_NAME) && [ -n "$CONTAINER_ID" ] && docker restart $CONTAINER_ID || docker run -d --name $APP_NAME $IMAGE

error_message:
FATAL: Container failed health check 3 times and has been stopped. Reason: unhealthy
failed to start service: health check timeout after 30s

error_message:
Error while creating mount source path '/var/data/app': mkdir /var/data/app: permission denied
Container failed to start.

container my-service stopped unexpectedly (exit code: 1). The last output was:
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference

Verify that the credentials are correct, that the required access is provided, and try again.

error_message:
##[error]Docker pull failed with exit code 1
Got permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon socket at unix:///var/run/docker.sock: Post http:///var/run/docker.sock/v1.40/images/create?fromImage=golang&tag=1.13.9-alpine3.10: dial unix /var/run/docker.sock: connect: permission denied

root_cause: Docker Hub anonymous pull rate limit (100 pulls per 6 hours per IP) exceeded on shared CI runner

error_message:
Error: ImagePullBackOff - Back-off pulling image "ghcr.io/owner/repo:latest"

root_cause: Public ECR gallery requires authentication in certain regions; Docker daemon unauthenticated to public.ecr.aws
fix_command: aws ecr-public get-login-password --region us-east-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin public.ecr.aws && docker pull public.ecr.aws/lambda/python:3.11

error pulling image configuration: unknown blob

docker: Error response from daemon: Get registry-auth-token: unauthorized

root_cause: Current user is not a member of the docker group and has no access to the Docker Unix socket

root_cause: SSH-deployed user account is not in the docker group on the target deployment host

error_message:
docker: Got permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon socket at unix:///var/run/docker.sock: Post http:///var/run/docker.sock/v1.38/containers/create: dial unix /var/run/docker.sock: connect: permission denied.
See 'docker run --help'.
root_cause: Jenkins build agent user not added to docker group; requires post-installation docker configuration step

error_message: [docker-perm] docker: Got permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon socket at unix:///var/run/docker.sock: Post http:///var/run/docker.sock/v1.26/build?dockerfile=Dockerfile&t=abc:1.0&...: dial unix /var/run/docker.sock: connect: permission denied
root_cause: Gradle Docker plugin runs as the current user which lacks docker group membership on the build host
fix_command: sudo usermod -aG docker $USER && newgrp docker && ./gradlew docker

root_cause: Docker Desktop 4.28+ on Windows changed docker.sock group ownership; containers inside no longer see docker group

error_message:
ERROR (SSHKit::Command::Failed): docker exit status: 1
docker stderr: permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon socket at unix:///var/run/docker.sock: Post "http:///var/run/docker.sock/v1.24/auth"
root_cause: Kamal deploy SSH user lacks docker group membership on remote server, preventing registry login step
fix_command: kamal accessory boot && ssh $HOST 'sudo usermod -aG docker $KAMAL_USER && sudo systemctl restart sshd'

error_message:
AWS ECR get-login-password | docker login --password-stdin ERROR: permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon socket
failed with: Getting Got permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon socket
root_cause: GitLab CI DIND runner user not in docker group inside the sibling Docker container spawned by the executor
fix_command: chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock && docker login -u AWS -p $(aws ecr get-login-password) $ECR_URI

error_message: panic: Got permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon socket at unix:///var/run/docker.sock: Get http:///var/run/docker.sock/_ping: dial unix /var/run/docker.sock: connect: permission denied
root_cause: Podman on macOS does not expose docker socket with correct permissions for rootless containers accessing it via symlink

error_message:
WARN: Docker daemon socket file permission issue: /var/run/docker.sock is group root instead of group docker.
Command failed: docker build .
root_cause: Docker systemd service socket group changed to root after a daemon update, excluding docker group members

error_message:
error: failed to run docker: permission denied
Failed to create overlay network: operation not permitted (requires CAP_NET_ADMIN)
root_cause: Docker container running without required CAP_NET_ADMIN capability in a privileged CI environment

root_cause: Docker networking setup fails inside a container without CAP_NET_ADMIN; typically in rootless or nested Docker

root_cause: Rootless Docker cannot map user namespaces because kernel userns_clone is disabled in system security policy

error_message:
Job for docker.service failed because the control process exited with error code.
See "systemctl status docker.service" and "journalctl -xe" for details.
root_cause: Docker daemon failed to start because of corrupted overlay2 metadata or invalid daemon.json configuration
fix_command: sudo systemctl stop docker && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/docker/network && sudo systemctl start docker

error_message: Error starting daemon: Error initializing network controller: could not delete the default bridge network: network bridge id e5b1ae8b2d6f has active endpoints
root_cause: Docker daemon cannot start because previous network bridge has zombie endpoints from improper shutdown
fix_command: sudo ip link del docker0 && sudo systemctl restart docker

error_message: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon at unix:///var/run/docker.sock. Is the docker daemon running?
root_cause: Docker daemon is not running on the CI host; service not configured to auto-start or crashed at boot
fix_command: sudo systemctl enable docker && sudo systemctl start docker

error_message:

Aug 01 09:22:11 hostname dockerd[1234]: time="2024-08-01T09:22:11.123Z" level=warning msg="Failed to load containers" error="...overlay2 layer data inconsistent"
root_cause: Docker daemon fails to start after unclean shutdown left overlay2 metadata in inconsistent state
fix_command: sudo systemctl stop docker && sudo find /var/lib/docker/overlay2 -maxdepth 1 -type d -empty -delete && sudo systemctl start docker

error_message:
dockerd: error layer driver not supported by kernel
Error starting daemon: overlay2 storage driver not supported on kernel
root_cause: Docker overlay2 storage driver requires kernel 4.0+ and d_type support on XFS; current kernel/filesystem lacks it
fix_command: sudo docker info 2>&1 | grep 'Storage Driver' && sudo sed -i 's/overlay2/vfs/g' /etc/docker/daemon.json && sudo systemctl restart docker

error_message: Error response from daemon: error while creating mount source path '/var/lib/docker/volumes/mydata/_data': mkdir /var/lib/docker/volumes: permission denied
root_cause: Docker data directory has incorrect ownership preventing volume creation after manual directory modification
fix_command: sudo chown -R root:root /var/lib/docker && sudo chmod 700 /var/lib/docker && sudo systemctl restart docker

Starting docker service...

root_cause: Docker daemon.json contains an invalid or overlapping default address pool CIDR configuration
fix_command: sudo sed -i '/default-address-pools/,+3d' /etc/docker/daemon.json && sudo systemctl restart docker

error_message:
dockerd: error loading TLS key pair: open /etc/docker/certs.d/registry.company.com/client.key: no such file or directory
service start failed
root_cause: Docker daemon configured to use TLS client auth for a registry but the certificate files are missing
fix_command: sudo mkdir -p /etc/docker/certs.d/$REGISTRY && sudo cp $CERT_PATH/client.cert /etc/docker/certs.d/$REGISTRY/ && sudo cp $CERT_PATH/client.key /etc/docker/certs.d/$REGISTRY/ && sudo systemctl restart docker

error_message: Failed to reload docker daemon: The docker daemon failed to reload configuration. Is /etc/docker/daemon.json valid JSON?
root_cause: daemon.json contains invalid JSON syntax, preventing Docker daemon from loading the configuration on restart
fix_command: python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/etc/docker/daemon.json')); print('valid')" || vi /etc/docker/daemon.json && sudo systemctl restart docker

error_message:
docker.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE
dockerexited (code=exited, status=1) since the system process was abruptly terminated
root_cause: Docker service failed to start due to corrupted Docker state from a prior forced system shutdown
fix_command: sudo systemctl stop docker && sudo rm -f /var/lib/docker/*.pid /run/docker.pid && sudo systemctl start docker

error_message: Error: Could not connect to ECR. An error occurred (ExpiredTokenException) when calling the GetAuthorizationToken operation: Token has expired
root_cause: ECR authentication token is only valid for 12 hours; CI job exceeded that window without re-authenticating
fix_command: aws ecr get-login-password --region $REGION | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin $ECR_REGISTRY

fix_command: docker tag $IMAGE $ECR_REGISTRY/$REPO:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) && docker push $ECR_REGISTRY/$REPO:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)

error: failed to push some refs to 'https://github.com/company/repo.git'
hint: Updates were rejected because the remote contains work that you do not have locally.

git exited with code 128
